## About
Greenlight Auto Care is a family-owned and operated repair shop on Clairemont Mesa Blvd in San Diego. Whether you drive an import or a domestic car, bring it to us for scheduled maintenance, bigger technical repairs, or a simple oil change.
Jerry Sample, Jr. is an ASE Master Technician who was originally factory-trained on Honda and Acura, and he will tackle any car. He likes to show you what he thinks is wrong and how he plans to fix it, often with drawings and diagrams.
We want to keep you and your vehicle safe and on the road. We may not be related, but we hope you'll feel like family here.

## Services
- Scheduled maintenance: Scheduled maintenance and technical repairs for import and domestic cars.
- Oil and filter changes: One longtime customer has had everything from basic oil and filter changes to a timing chain replacement done here.
- Diagnostics: Up-to-date diagnostic equipment to find the problem and get you back on the road.
- Timing belt and major maintenance: One reviewer had the timing belt, water pump and tensioner done on a Toyota Tundra.
- Battery replacement: One reviewer brought in a Subaru Crosstrek for a simple battery replacement.

## FAQ
Q: What are your hours?
A: We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM.

Q: Do you only work on Honda and Acura?
A: No. Jerry was originally factory-trained on Honda and Acura, but he will work on any car. If you don't see yours listed, give us a call.

Q: Can I text my questions?
A: Yes. You can text Jerry directly at 619-587-2131.

Q: How soon will you reply to a message?
A: Please include the year, make and model of your car, and allow 24 to 48 hours for a reply.

## What customers say
- "Greenlight Auto Care may be known as a Honda/Acura specialist, but they had no problem helping me out with my Subaru Crosstrek for a simple battery replacement. I brought my own battery, and they didn’t give me a hard time about it at all. They got me in and out fast, basically within 30 minutes, and the actual battery swap took about 20 minutes.

The labor charge was very reasonable, the process was easy, and nobody tried to upsell me or complicate what should have been a straightforward job. While I was waiting, I overheard the front desk talking with regular customers, and it honestly had the feel of a family shop where people know and trust them.

Even though I’m not driving a Honda or Acura, I’d be happy to come back. Good service, fair price, and a no-nonsense experience." (Austin G, 5/5)
- "I recently had a major round of maintenance completed on my Toyota Tundra, including the timing belt, water pump, tensioner, and I couldn’t be more satisfied with the results.

The work was done thoroughly and professionally. The timing belt and water pump service is critical on these trucks, and everything was handled with attention to detail—no leaks, no odd noises, and the engine is running smoother and quieter than before. The whole system feels tight and properly dialed in.

If you’re maintaining a Tundra and need major service done right, this experience gave me a lot of confidence in the longevity of my truck. Everything feels solid, reliable, and ready for the long haul." (Alexander Knipper, 5/5)
- "My 2016 Honda is the first new car I've ever bought. I started having bad experiences at the dealer once the warranty ran out and the service manager I liked got promoted. I can't imagine going anywhere else!" (Becky LaVonne, 5/5)
